# IT Crista - Shopify Development & Tech Solutions

> itcrista.in provides high-quality Shopify development, custom e-commerce solutions, and tech integration services.

## Core Expertise & Services
- **Shopify Development:** Custom theme setup, liquid programming, and store optimization.
- **E-commerce Solutions:** End-to-end development for online brands and businesses.
- **API Integrations:** Seamless third-party app and tool connections for Shopify.
